config.slimeform.title: Slime Form Settings
config.slimeform.max_slime_size.tooltip: Largest size a player can reach (1-10).
config.slimeform.slime_balls_required.to: Slime balls needed per size increase.
Show held items inside sleeping and dormant slimes.
config.slimeform.split_duration.tooltip: Time before a split slime reforms.
config.slimeform.recovery_hostile_reform: Stop size-1 reforming while a fragment is in danger: a hostile can reach it, or one is within a few blocks.
config.slimeform.recovery_reform_cost.to: You reform as big as the slime you gathered. Lost fragments make you come back smaller, never bigger than before you died.
config.slimeform.recovery_flee_path_debu: Show the flee path and nearby hostiles.
config.slimeform.recovery_flee_danger_de: Show a bossbar for the nearest hostile.
Show each slime's lineage ID and generation.
config.slimeform.afk_enabled.tooltip: Inactive players become a protected dormant slime.
config.slimeform.afk_duration.tooltip: Idle time before going dormant. Blocked in combat or danger.
config.slimeform.afk_debug.tooltip: Show the dormant countdown above the hotbar.
config.slimeform.afk_hud_debug.tooltip: Show a slider for the last 10 seconds.
config.slimeform.slime_sounds_enabled.to: Master switch. Off restores vanilla player sounds and removes the extra slime sounds.
config.slimeform.slime_sound_footsteps.t: Slime squish instead of footstep sounds.
config.slimeform.slime_sound_landing.too: Squish when landing after a fall.
config.slimeform.slime_sound_fall.toolti: Slime squish instead of the small and big fall sounds.
config.slimeform.slime_sound_attack.tool: Slime sounds for hits, swings and shield deflects.
config.slimeform.slime_sound_growth.tool: Squish when eating a slime ball to grow.
config.slimeform.water_behavior.tooltip: Sink slower in water. Drowning still applies.
config.slimeform.item_display_bob_amplit: How much items bob up and down.
config.slimeform.slime_chunks_enabled.to: Chunks within 8 of you may act as slime chunks.
config.slimeform.slime_chunk_chance.tool: Chance each nearby chunk counts as a slime chunk.
config.slimeform.slime_morph_enabled.too: Toggle a full slime morph with a key.
config.slimeform.swamp_spawn_enabled.too: Spawn in the nearest swamp if you have no bed or anchor.
config.slimeform.player_transparency.too: Transparency of your Slime Form avatar. In slime shell mode, this fades the outer shell while keeping you opaque.
config.slimeform.player_transparency_sli: Tint your transparent avatar green. The slime shell uses its own texture instead.
Keep your avatar opaque and cover it with a translucent, avatar-shaped slime layer.
config.slimeform.absorb_enabled.tooltip: Allow slimes to absorb entities on contact.
Allow slimes to absorb other players.
config.slimeform.absorb_bosses_enabled.t: Allow large slimes to absorb Withers, Elder Guardians, and Wardens.
Fraction of slime volume available to hold absorbed entities.
Base acid damage dealt per second to digesting entities at size 2.
config.slimeform.absorb_digest_dps_per_s: Additional acid damage dealt per second for each slime size above size 2.
config.slimeform.absorb_digest_interval_: Interval in ticks between acid digestion pulses (20 ticks = 1 second).
config.slimeform.absorb_struggle_jump_ga: Escape progress percentage added each time an absorbed player taps Jump.
config.slimeform.absorb_struggle_hit_gai: Escape progress percentage added to trapped players when the holder slime is struck from outside.
config.slimeform.absorb_struggle_decay.t: Escape progress percentage lost per second when an absorbed player is not struggling.
config.slimeform.absorb_fullness_slowdow: Maximum movement speed penalty as held volume approaches capacity (linear up to -25%).
slimeform.absorb.gastric_spasm: Gastric spasm! Your body violently regurgitated %s!
slimeform.absorb.wither_enrage_rupture: The Wither went enraged and violently breached hold containment!

slimeform.mutation.elder_guardian.unlock: Mutation Assimilated: Prismatic Hydro-Jet! (Water Breathing + Dolphin's Grace + Hydrodynamic Swim)
